business.name: JD MECHATRONICS
business.about: Based in Baalbek, Lebanon, JD MECHATRONICS is your trusted partner for manufacturing and repairing all types of CNC machines. We combine deep technical expertise with hands-on experience to deliver precision results every time.

services.title: CNC Router
services.desc: Manufacturing, installation, calibration and full repair services for all CNC router types — 3-axis, 4-axis and 5-axis systems.

services.title: CO₂ Laser
services.desc: Expert service for CO₂ laser cutting and engraving machines. Tube replacement, alignment, and complete system overhaul.

services.title: Fiber Laser
services.desc: High-power fiber laser cutting machine manufacturing and repair. Precision maintenance for metal cutting systems.

services.title: Fiber Marking
services.desc: Fiber laser marking machine service and repair. Optimal beam quality maintenance for detailed marking applications.

services.title: UV Laser
services.desc: UV laser system manufacturing and repair for cold processing on sensitive materials and ultra-fine marking.

services.title: Custom Solutions
services.desc: Need something specific? Contact us for custom CNC manufacturing, upgrades, and specialized solutions tailored to your needs.
